title: gynoxys laciniata
intro: Gynoxys laciniata, commonly known as the Cut-leaf Gynoxys or Cut-leaved Gynoxys, is a plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gynoxys laciniata include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
